article.title: 1 [Specific performance in respect of contracts.
article.content: The specific performance of a contract shall be enforced by the court subject to the provisions contained in sub-section (2) of section 11, section 14 and section 16.]
article.html:
101[Specific performance in respect of contracts.

Section 10 · Part II · Chapter II · CONTRACTS WHICH CAN BE SPECIFICALLY ENFORCED · page 5 of the Act

The specific performance of a contract shall be enforced by the court subject to the provisions contained in sub-section (2) of section 11, section 14 and section 16.]

1 Subs. by Act 18 of 2018, s 3, for section 10 (w.e.f. 1-10-2018).
